episodes.title: Halloween Special
episodes.description: A Halloween episode featuring seasonal crafts, spooky-but-chic decorating, and a performance by Shoshana Bean from the Broadway musical Wicked. Martha demonstrates her signature approach to making Halloween sophisticated rather than kitschy.

guests.name: Shoshana Bean
guests.context: Broadway actress; performed 'No Good Deed' from Wicked

episodes.title: Il Divo Holiday Concert
episodes.description: A holiday episode featuring classical crossover group Il Divo, who speak with Martha about their Christmas album and perform 'Oh Holy Night.' Martha prepares an elegant holiday table setting and demonstrates her signature spritz cookies.

guests.name: Il Divo
guests.context: Classical crossover vocal group; performed 'Oh Holy Night' from The Christmas Collection

episodes.title: Holiday Cookie Special
episodes.description: A full episode devoted to Martha's legendary Christmas cookie assortment. She makes seven different varieties in one show — a record for efficiency — and demonstrates how to set up a proper decorating station for group baking.

episodes.title: David Boreanaz and Walt Willey
episodes.description: Actor David Boreanaz joins Martha alongside soap opera star Walt Willey for an episode that mixes celebrity cooking with lighter fare. Martha demonstrates a delicate lemon soufflé and oiled sardines on toast — an elegant combination she defends enthusiastically.

guests.name: David Boreanaz
guests.context: Actor known for Bones and Buffy; appeared as a cooking enthusiast

guests.name: Walt Willey
guests.context: Soap opera actor; co-appeared in cooking segment

episodes.title: Kermit the Frog Visits
episodes.description: Kermit the Frog visits Martha's show in a delightful segment that became one of the series' most-remembered appearances. Kermit discusses his NASA visit and promotes environmental causes, while Martha makes his favorite treats.

guests.name: Kermit the Frog
guests.context: Jim Henson's most famous Muppet character; discussed NASA visit and promoted Ford Hybrid

episodes.title: Poncho Day
episodes.description: The show's second episode leans into comedy: David Spade joins Martha for a conversation about bachelor cooking while Elmo from Sesame Street stops by for a crafting segment. Martha makes simple pasta and a fruit tart, demonstrating how even basic food can be elevated.

guests.name: David Spade
guests.context: Comedian and actor; discussed bachelor cooking

guests.name: Elmo
guests.context: Sesame Street Muppet; appeared in crafting segment

episodes.title: Mom's Birthday
episodes.description: Martha dedicates this episode to birthday celebrations, welcoming her mother Martha Kostyra to the show. They prepare a family birthday dinner together, sharing stories from Martha's childhood in Nutley, New Jersey.

guests.name: Martha Kostyra
guests.context: Martha Stewart's mother; appeared in birthday episode

episodes.title: Everyday Food Challenge
episodes.description: A competition-style episode featuring home cooks attempting to match Martha's speed and technique. Martha demonstrates her benchmark recipes — a perfect roast chicken and a simple vinaigrette — and judges audience members on their results.

episodes.title: Nancy Grace
episodes.description: Legal commentator and TV personality Nancy Grace visits Martha's studio alongside Ashley Jay Sandberg. Martha prepares a spring menu while Nancy Grace discusses her career as a prosecutor and her transition to television journalism.

guests.name: Nancy Grace
guests.context: Legal commentator and HLN TV host; discussed career as prosecutor and journalist

guests.name: Ashley Jay Sandberg
guests.context: Also appeared in this episode

episodes.title: Season 2 Premiere
episodes.description: Martha opens her second season with renewed energy, greeting viewers from her Bedford farm and making a fall harvest menu: a butternut squash and apple soup, a roast pork tenderloin with apple compote, and a simple apple tarte Tatin from the orchard.

episodes.title: Kermit Returns for Girl Scouts
episodes.description: Kermit the Frog makes his second visit to Martha's show, this time to sing 'Bein' Green' for a group of Girl Scouts in the studio audience. Martha leads a craft segment while Kermit entertains, creating a memorable intergenerational episode.

guests.name: Kermit the Frog

episodes.title: Ruben Studdard
episodes.description: American Idol Season 2 winner Ruben Studdard joins Martha for a musical performance and cooking segment. Martha prepares soul food favorites in his honor — fried catfish, collard greens, and a sweet potato pie — honoring the Southern tradition that shaped Studdard's style.

guests.name: Ruben Studdard

episodes.title: Michael Kors and Aerin Lauder
episodes.description: Fashion designer Michael Kors and Estée Lauder heiress Aerin Lauder join Martha for a style-forward episode that bridges fashion and entertaining. Martha demonstrates how to set an elegant table on a budget while the guests discuss their design philosophies.

guests.name: Michael Kors

episodes.description: David Boreanaz returns to Martha's show for a second visit, this time promoting the fourth season of Bones. Martha and the actor prepare a cast-iron skillet dinner — seared steak with herb butter and roasted vegetables — that the Bones set reportedly adopted as a crew meal.

guests.name: David Boreanaz
guests.context: Actor known for Bones and Angel; returned for second visit promoting Bones Season 4

episodes.title: Fall Harvest
episodes.description: Season 3 opens with a harvest-themed episode that showcases Martha's farm at its autumn best. She prepares a butternut squash soup, a roasted beet salad, and an apple galette from fruit picked that morning.

episodes.title: Crafts Week Premiere
episodes.description: Martha opens Season 4 with a week devoted to crafts, welcoming Rosie O'Donnell, Alexis Stewart, and Jennifer Koppelman Hutt for the series' first 'Crafts Week' — a themed programming block that became an annual tradition. The premiere showcases elaborately decorated boxes, hand-stamped stationery, and a demonstration of Martha's papier-mâché technique.

episodes.title: Halloween with Blake Lively
episodes.description: Gossip Girl star Blake Lively visits Martha's show for a Halloween episode that was one of the most-watched of Season 4. Lively, then 21, helps Martha construct elaborate Halloween costumes from everyday materials while Martha makes a dramatic spider web cake.

guests.name: Blake Lively
guests.context: Actress known for Gossip Girl; helped create Halloween costumes

episodes.title: Snoop Dogg Guest

guests.name: Snoop Dogg

episodes.title: Season 5 Premiere at Skylands
episodes.description: Martha opens Season 5 from Skylands, her summer estate in Maine, showcasing the dramatic landscape and abundant gardens. She makes a lobster roll using fresh-caught Maine lobster, a blueberry buckle, and a cold brew iced tea sweetened with lavender syrup.

episodes.title: Ask Michael Moore
episodes.description: Filmmaker Michael Moore, fresh from his documentary Capitalism: A Love Story, visits Martha's studio. Martha makes a no-frills Midwest-inspired dinner — a meatloaf, boiled potatoes, and apple crisp — that Moore praises as the food of his childhood.

guests.name: Michael Moore
guests.context: Documentary filmmaker; visited after releasing Capitalism: A Love Story

episodes.title: Holiday Cookies with Snoop Dogg
episodes.description: A surprise second appearance from Snoop Dogg — this time for a holiday cookie decorating episode that became one of the most-shared clips from the show's run. Snoop and Martha's dynamic in a kitchen full of royal icing and piping bags was pure television.

guests.name: Snoop Dogg
guests.context: Rapper; returned for holiday cookie decorating episode; dynamic with Martha went viral

episodes.title: Alice Waters
episodes.description: Legendary chef and food activist Alice Waters visits Martha's kitchen to discuss her philosophy of simple, seasonal, organic cooking. They make a market salad with whatever was available that morning, a simple pasta with olive oil and herbs, and Waters' signature almond tart.

guests.name: Alice Waters
guests.context: Chef, food activist, founder of Chez Panisse; discussed seasonal organic cooking philosophy

recipes: Pasta with Olive Oil and Herbs

episodes.title: Amanda Seyfried
episodes.description: Actress Amanda Seyfried joins Martha for a spring gardening and cooking episode. They plant an herb garden together and prepare a simple spring menu using fresh herbs — grilled fish with herb butter, spring pea soup, and a lemon herb tart.

guests.name: Amanda Seyfried
guests.context: Actress known for Mamma Mia and Dear John; helped plant herb garden and cook

episodes.title: Season 6 Premiere
episodes.description: Martha opens Season 6 with a back-to-school theme, transforming classic lunchbox staples into elevated versions of themselves. She makes a gourmet grilled cheese with Gruyère and caramelized onions, a sophisticated take on tomato soup, and an oat-and-honey granola bar.

episodes.title: Consignment Fashion Show
episodes.description: A fashion-focused episode highlighting the growing trend of consignment and vintage shopping. Martha hosts a runway segment featuring thrifted outfits styled by fashion editors, while also demonstrating how to refresh and tailor secondhand clothing at home.

episodes.title: The Comfort Food Show
episodes.description: A winter comfort food episode with Luke Perry demonstrating his take on pulled pork, and pastry chef Joanne Chang sharing her famous doughnuts. Martha rounds out the episode with a proper French onion soup with a melted Gruyère crust.

guests.name: Luke Perry
guests.context: Actor known for Beverly Hills 90210 and Riverdale; demonstrated pulled pork

guests.name: Joanne Chang
guests.context: Pastry chef and owner of Flour Bakery in Boston; shared doughnut recipe

episodes.title: Westminster Dog Show Special
episodes.description: Martha devotes an episode to the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show, held that week in New York City. She interviews handlers and breed experts, profiles two of her own chow chows, and makes dog-friendly treats alongside people-friendly cocktail party fare.

episodes.title: Cast Iron Cooking
episodes.description: A full episode devoted to the cast-iron skillet, Martha's most-used pan. She demonstrates a cast-iron seared duck breast, a skillet cornbread baked directly in the oven, and a Dutch baby pancake that puffs dramatically in the final moments.

episodes.title: Spring Weddings
episodes.description: With the wedding season approaching, Martha dedicates an episode to spring wedding traditions — from flowers to food. She makes a tier of cucumber sandwiches, a champagne punch, and demonstrates two different wedding cake decoration styles for home bakers.

episodes.title: The Mother's Day Show
episodes.description: The final episode of Martha's seven-year daytime run, broadcast on Mother's Day weekend. Martha wraps the show with emotion and grace, making her most iconic dishes — pavlova, lemon curd, roast chicken — and thanks the audience that supported the show through everything.

episodes.title: Easter Celebration Southern-Style
episodes.description: A Southern-inflected Easter spread: a honey-glazed country ham, deviled eggs with a tangy mustard filling, and a rich coconut layer cake. Martha draws from Southern American tradition while maintaining her characteristic precision.

episodes.title: Baking Breads and Cakes
episodes.description: Martha covers the basic architecture of leavened baking: a white sandwich loaf, a classic pound cake, and a simple banana bread. The episode explains how different leaveners — yeast, baking powder, baking soda — produce distinct results.

episodes.title: Easy Apple Recipes
episodes.description: Three ways with autumn apples: a rustic galette with a flaky free-form crust, a spiced applesauce simmered in a wide pan until thick, and a sautéed apple compote for serving alongside pork chops.

episodes.title: Steak and Potatoes
episodes.description: The steakhouse dinner at home: Martha pan-sears a bone-in strip steak in a cast-iron skillet, makes crispy smashed potatoes roasted in duck fat, and whips up a peppercorn cream sauce from the pan drippings.

episodes.title: Studio Tour and Organizing a Kitchen
episodes.description: Martha takes viewers behind the scenes of her television kitchen, explaining how to organize a workspace for maximum efficiency. She discusses knife storage, mise en place, and the tools that earn permanent counter space.

episodes.title: Host a Soup Party
episodes.description: A soup party is the most forgiving of dinner party formats: Martha makes a rich ribollita, a chilled gazpacho for summer, and a silky butternut squash purée, setting up a self-serve station with toppings and crusty bread.

episodes.title: Four Great Salads
episodes.description: Martha builds four composed salads with distinct character: a Niçoise with olive-oil-packed tuna, a warm lentil salad with dijon vinaigrette, a crunchy endive with blue cheese and walnuts, and a simple cucumber-dill salad.

episodes.title: Spring Dinner
episodes.description: A spring dinner menu built around what's first in the market: asparagus with brown butter and shaved parmesan, lamb chops with mint gremolata, and a rhubarb fool for dessert.

episodes.title: Three Spring Recipes
episodes.description: Three quick preparations from spring's first produce: pea and mint crostini, grilled asparagus with lemon zest and fleur de sel, and a simple strawberry and cream dessert.

episodes.title: Winter Squash Recipes
episodes.description: Martha explores the full family of winter squash: roasted delicata with maple glaze, a creamy acorn squash soup, and a stuffed spaghetti squash with sage brown butter and toasted pine nuts.

episodes.title: Preparing a Dinner Party
episodes.description: A full dinner party walkthrough: Martha plans a menu, prepares a timeline, sets the table, and executes a three-course meal — a goat cheese tart starter, braised short ribs, and a chocolate mousse — explaining how to pace the kitchen work.

episodes.title: Lamb and Lemons
episodes.description: Lamb and lemon are natural partners. Martha makes a slow-roasted leg of lamb with preserved lemon gremolata, a quick sauté of ground lamb with orzo and lemon zest, and a lemon-scented rack of lamb with herb crust.

episodes.title: Spring Garden Cake
episodes.description: Martha bakes a carrot cake from scratch — freshly grated carrots, warm spices, toasted walnuts — and finishes it with an exceptionally thick layer of cream cheese frosting. She also makes a lighter angel food cake with fresh strawberries.
recipes: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting

episodes.title: Kid-Friendly Foods
episodes.description: Recipes children will actually eat, made with real ingredients. Martha makes proper macaroni and cheese with sharp cheddar and a breadcrumb crust, fruit-and-oat granola bars, and mini meatballs in a simple tomato sauce.

episodes.title: Seasonal Fall Desserts
episodes.description: The flavors of autumn in dessert form: a pear and ginger upside-down cake, a quince tarte Tatin made with the season's underused fruit, and a dense walnut brownie that improves on the second day.

episodes.title: Homemade Bread
episodes.description: An episode devoted to bread without a mixer: a no-knead boule developed over 12 hours, a quick skillet cornbread ready in 30 minutes, and a focaccia made in an oiled baking sheet with whatever's in the pantry.

episodes.title: Favorite Breakfast Recipes
episodes.description: Three of Martha's most dependable morning preparations: Dutch baby pancakes for a crowd, ricotta fritters served with warm jam, and steel-cut oatmeal cooked the overnight method for a creamy, effortless weekday breakfast.

episodes.title: Comfort Food
episodes.description: The dishes people cook when they need feeding rather than impressing. Martha makes a proper beef stew with root vegetables and thickened gravy, a loaded baked potato with all the trimmings, and a warm chocolate chip cookie straight from the oven.

episodes.title: Quick-Cook Dinner Ideas
episodes.description: Five weeknight dinners that each come together in under 30 minutes. Martha makes a fast shrimp scampi with linguine, a pan-seared pork tenderloin with apples, and a quick chicken piccata with capers and lemon.

episodes.title: Martha's Family Recipes
episodes.description: Martha revisits the recipes that shaped her earliest cooking memories: her mother's pierogies with butter and caramelized onions, a Polish beet soup with sour cream, and apple strudel made by hand from thin dough.

episodes.title: Fast and Easy Salads
episodes.description: Celebrity chef Mario Batali joins Martha to demonstrate his approach to Italian salad: a Venetian-style chicory salad dressed with anchovy and red wine vinegar, a warm bread salad with roasted peppers, and a raw zucchini salad with ricotta salata.

guests.name: Mario Batali
guests.context: Celebrity Italian-American chef; demonstrated Italian salad technique

episodes.title: Easter Celebration
episodes.description: Easter across two traditions: Martha makes a glorious lamb roast with rosemary and garlic for the main course, naturally dyed Easter eggs using beet juice and red cabbage, and a pastel-frosted layer cake for the holiday table.

episodes.title: Lemon Desserts and Citrus Ideas
episodes.description: Citrus in all its forms for dessert and beyond. Martha makes a lemon semifreddo, a Sicilian orange-scented olive oil cake, and a grapefruit curd tart that brings a bitter note to balance the sweet.

episodes.title: On the Lighter Side
episodes.description: Martha recalibrates for lighter eating without sacrificing flavor: a steamed fish in parchment with ginger and scallions, a grain salad with roasted vegetables and tahini, and a fruit-and-yogurt parfait for dessert.

episodes.title: Pizza Party
episodes.description: Martha makes pizza dough from scratch — the two-day cold-ferment method for maximum flavor — then sets up three different pies: a classic Margherita, a white pizza with ricotta and arugula, and a dessert pizza with Nutella and sliced strawberries.

episodes.title: Pies, Pies, and More Pies
episodes.description: An episode devoted entirely to pie, covering both sweet and savory. Martha makes a proper double-crust apple pie, a chicken pot pie in individual ramekins, and a silky chocolate cream pie with a cookie crust.

episodes.title: Jam Treats
episodes.description: Jam as an ingredient and as a standalone preserve. Martha makes a thumbprint cookie with apricot jam center, a layered Victoria sponge filled with raspberry jam and cream, and a quick stovetop strawberry jam from fresh berries.

episodes.title: Sweet and Savory Corn
episodes.description: Corn at its summer peak: a sweet corn soup with chive cream, corn fritters served with sour cream and chives, and a corn and black bean salad with lime dressing and cotija cheese.

episodes.title: Healthy Fish Recipes
episodes.description: Three fish preparations designed for weeknight ease and nutritional value: a poached salmon with cucumber-dill sauce, a roasted cod with cherry tomatoes and olives, and a tuna and white bean salad.

episodes.title: Football Party
episodes.description: Game-day food that's made to eat standing up: a slow-cooker chili with all the toppings, loaded nachos with homemade guacamole and pickled jalapeños, and buffalo-style chicken wings with blue cheese dipping sauce.

episodes.title: Family-Style Italian Cooking
episodes.description: Italian cooking at its most convivial: a giant bowl of rigatoni all'amatriciana for the center of the table, a whole roasted branzino with herbs, and tiramisu made the night before in a large dish.

episodes.title: Firehouse Favorites for the Super Bowl
episodes.description: Inspired by cooking for a crowd, Martha makes a sheet pan of lasagna, a large-batch potato salad, and a crowd-pleasing brownie with a cream cheese swirl — all designed to feed a group efficiently.

episodes.title: Pork Loin Dinner Menu
episodes.description: Pork loin as the centerpiece of a complete dinner: a sage-and-garlic-stuffed loin tied into a roast, a white bean and escarole gratin alongside, and a cider-braised apple compote as the sweet-savory condiment.

episodes.title: Breakfast Favorites
episodes.description: Martha's favorite breakfast foods made from scratch: buttermilk pancakes stacked high with warm maple syrup, homemade granola with dried fruit and nuts, and a classic eggs Benedict with foolproof hollandaise.

episodes.title: Comfort Food Favorites
episodes.description: An anthology of the recipes viewers request most: chicken and dumplings made in one pot, mashed potatoes at their absolute silkiest, and a warm skillet brownie served with vanilla ice cream.

episodes.title: South of the Border
episodes.description: Martha cooks Mexican and Central American classics: fresh guacamole made tableside, chicken enchiladas smothered in a house mole, and churros with chocolate dipping sauce.

episodes.title: Seasonal Autumn Dinner Recipes
episodes.description: Martha embraces fall harvest ingredients: a butternut squash soup with crème fraîche, a roast pork tenderloin glazed with apple cider, and a cranberry tart in a butter crust.

episodes.title: Classic Fall Favorites With Martha Stewart
episodes.description: Martha revisits timeless fall recipes: a perfectly crisped apple pie, braised short ribs with root vegetables, and a pumpkin bread pudding with caramel sauce.

episodes.title: Breakfast Favorites
episodes.description: Martha makes three beloved breakfast classics: buttermilk pancakes with real maple syrup, a bacon and cheddar frittata for a crowd, and fresh-baked cinnamon rolls with cream cheese glaze.

episodes.title: Soup and Salad Favorites
episodes.description: Martha builds a satisfying meal around three recipes: a hearty lentil soup, a winter citrus salad with endive and walnuts, and a simple baguette with herb butter.

episodes.title: Quick-Cook Family Dinner
episodes.description: A weeknight dinner designed to be on the table in 45 minutes: a fast chicken stir-fry with ginger and scallions over steamed rice, a simple cucumber salad, and a pantry dessert of sliced bananas with caramel sauce.

episodes.title: Mastering Italian Favorites
episodes.description: A celebration of Italian cooking fundamentals: handmade pappardelle tossed with a slow-simmered ragù, bruschetta with roasted tomatoes and fresh basil, and a classic tiramisu with espresso-soaked ladyfingers.

episodes.title: Steak and Salad Menu
episodes.description: An elegant but achievable dinner: a skillet-seared flank steak marinated in soy and ginger, a composed salad of arugula, shaved parmesan, and lemon, and garlic bread toasted under the broiler.

episodes.title: The Perfect Brunch
episodes.description: Martha creates an impressive brunch spread: eggs Benedict with silky hollandaise, smoked salmon with cream cheese and capers on toasted brioche, and a mixed berry clafoutis fresh from the oven.

episodes.title: Adding a Twist to Classic Side Dishes
episodes.description: Martha elevates everyday sides with unexpected flavors: roasted Brussels sprouts with pancetta and balsamic, a cauliflower gratin with Gruyère, and mashed potatoes enriched with goat cheese and chives.

episodes.title: Explore the Fulton Fish Market
episodes.description: Martha visits New York's historic Fulton Fish Market before dawn to select the morning's catch, then returns to the kitchen to prepare a whole roasted sea bass, a simple ceviche, and a clam chowder made from live clams purchased hours earlier.

guests.name: Fulton Fish Market Vendors
guests.context: Market fishmongers; demonstrated how to select fresh fish

episodes.title: Cooking With Chef Guillermo Pernot
episodes.description: Chef Guillermo Pernot demonstrates Latin holiday specialties: ceviche prepared in multiple Latin styles, a slow-braised pork with achiote and citrus, and a festive tres leches soaked in rum.

guests.name: Guillermo Pernot
guests.context: Chef specializing in Latin cuisine; James Beard Award winner

episodes.title: Southeast Asian Cuisine
episodes.description: Food writer Jeffrey Alford guides Martha through Southeast Asian flavors: a Thai green curry built from a homemade paste, Vietnamese-style spring rolls with rice paper, and a Malaysian rendang with coconut and galangal.

guests.name: Jeffrey Alford
guests.context: Food writer and author specializing in Asian cuisines

episodes.title: Dinner Recipes, in Minutes!
episodes.description: Martha demonstrates quick weeknight recipes: a 15-minute shrimp scampi over angel hair pasta, a simple sautéed chicken with lemon and capers, and a no-cook chocolate mousse prepared ahead.

episodes.title: Discovering Exotic Fruits and Spices
episodes.description: Martha explores less-familiar ingredients from global markets: star anise in a Chinese braised pork, cardamom in a Scandinavian rice pudding, and fresh lychee in a sorbet.

episodes.title: Authentic Moroccan Cuisine
episodes.description: Martha cooks from the Moroccan tradition: a slow-cooked chicken tagine with preserved lemon and olives, a carrot and cumin salad, and bastilla — the sweet-savory pigeon pie made with phyllo dough.

episodes.title: Cooking With Jody Adams
episodes.description: Boston chef Jody Adams joins Martha to demonstrate her approach to Portuguese-influenced New England cooking: a seafood stew in the tradition of a Portuguese caldeirada, salt cod croquettes, and a quince paste with aged cheese.

guests.name: Jody Adams
guests.context: Boston chef known for Portuguese-influenced New England cuisine

episodes.title: Holiday Entertaining with Martha Stewart
episodes.description: Martha Stewart's first major television appearance was this PBS/WGBH holiday special filmed at her Connecticut farmhouse. Covering both Thanksgiving and Christmas entertaining in one program, she guides viewers through a complete Yuletide plan — food preparation, table decoration, and seating arrangements — establishing the voice and aesthetic that would define her brand for the next four decades.

episodes.title: At Home with Martha Stewart: This Christmas
episodes.description: Tied to her 1989 Christmas book, this Lifetime special visits Martha at home for the holidays. She demonstrates her signature approach to decorating with natural materials — fresh greens, dried berries, magnolia leaves — and prepares a complete Christmas dinner from a menu that influenced a generation of holiday entertainers.

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Home for the Holidays
episodes.description: An early standalone CBS prime-time holiday special from the Martha Stewart Living era. Martha walks through her Bedford estate at Christmas — decorated with fresh greenery and paperwhites — alongside her mother and a guest appearance by Julia Child. They prepare a complete holiday dinner, discuss traditions, and Martha wraps the special with an eggnog toast.

guests.name: Julia Child
guests.context: Legendary cookbook author and TV cook; appeared as holiday guest

guests.name: Martha Kostyra
guests.context: Martha's mother; appeared in the holiday special

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Welcome Home for the Holidays
episodes.description: A second CBS prime-time holiday special that became famous for its unlikely celebrity lineup. Miss Piggy joins Martha to talk about her holiday traditions, Michael Jordan discusses his family's Thanksgiving, and Dennis Franz from NYPD Blue appears in the kitchen. Martha makes her classic tablescape and a holiday roast.

guests.name: Miss Piggy
guests.context: Muppet character; discussed her holiday traditions with Martha

guests.name: Michael Jordan
guests.context: NBA star; discussed his family's Thanksgiving traditions

guests.name: Dennis Franz
guests.context: Actor known for NYPD Blue; appeared in holiday cooking segment

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Home for the Holidays: The Family Tree
episodes.description: The 1999 CBS holiday special features Aretha Franklin in a memorable segment about soul food Christmas traditions and holiday music. Martha decorates her Bedford home using a family-heirloom ornament theme and demonstrates her recipe for the perfect standing rib roast.

guests.name: Aretha Franklin
guests.context: Queen of Soul; appeared to discuss soul food Christmas traditions and holiday music

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Christmas Dream
episodes.description: A turn-of-the-millennium holiday special featuring an all-star lineup. Tony Bennett performs holiday classics, Cyndi Lauper contributes a typically unconventional holiday segment, Lorraine Bracco discusses her Italian Christmas traditions, and Ana Gasteyer appears in a comedy sketch. Martha demonstrates her gingerbread village construction.

guests.name: Tony Bennett
guests.context: Legendary singer; performed holiday classics

guests.name: Cyndi Lauper
guests.context: Pop icon; contributed holiday segment

guests.name: Lorraine Bracco
guests.context: Actress known for The Sopranos; discussed Italian Christmas traditions

guests.name: Ana Gasteyer
guests.context: SNL actress; appeared in comedy sketch

episodes.title: Tricking and Treating with Martha Stewart
episodes.description: A Halloween special filmed at Martha's Bedford barn, focusing on elaborate Halloween decorating that's spooky without being cheap. Actor Brendan Fraser visits for a segment about costume crafting, and Martha demonstrates her technique for carving architectural jack-o'-lanterns.

guests.name: Brendan Fraser
guests.context: Actor; appeared in Halloween costume crafting segment

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Holiday Open House
episodes.description: A Christmas open house special featuring Jennifer Garner and Claire Danes as guests in Martha's holiday-decorated studio. Martha demonstrates creating a complete holiday tablescape, wreath construction from fresh materials, and a menu of elegant canapés for entertaining a crowd.

guests.name: Jennifer Garner
guests.context: Actress known for Alias and films; appeared in holiday entertaining segment

guests.name: Claire Danes
guests.context: Actress known for My So-Called Life and Homeland; appeared in holiday segment

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Egg-cellent Easter
episodes.description: An Easter special covering both the craft and culinary traditions of the holiday. Martha demonstrates natural egg dyeing using vegetable and plant-based dyes, constructs an egg-decorating station for a group, and prepares a complete Easter dinner menu anchored by a glazed ham with mustard crust.

episodes.title: Grilling Secrets of the Master Chefs
episodes.description: A summer grilling special bringing together three authority voices on live-fire cooking. Chris Schlesinger and Elizabeth Karmel demonstrate regional grilling styles from the American South and Southwest, while Emeril Lagasse shows how to build a proper fire and manage heat for different proteins.

guests.name: Chris Schlesinger
guests.context: Chef and grilling authority; demonstrated regional grilling

guests.name: Elizabeth Karmel
guests.context: Barbecue expert; demonstrated Southern and Southwestern grilling styles

guests.name: Emeril Lagasse
guests.context: Celebrity chef; demonstrated fire building and heat management

episodes.title: Martha Stewart's Haunted House
episodes.description: An ambitious Halloween special in which Martha transforms a garage into a full walk-through haunted house and corn maze — using theatrical techniques typically reserved for professional productions. She explains the principles of surprise, lighting, and theatrical fog that create authentic fright.

episodes.title: Roast Chicken 101; Luminaries; Succulent Strawberry Jars
episodes.description: The Season 5 premiere kicks off the show's new daily format. Martha demonstrates her authoritative approach to roast chicken, shows how to make decorative luminaries for evening lighting, and prepares succulent strawberry preserves from peak summer fruit.

episodes.title: Autumn Pantry; Wobbly Chair Repair; Three-Garlic Pasta
episodes.description: Martha stocks the autumn pantry with pickled vegetables and conserves, demonstrates how to repair a wobbly chair without professional help, and makes a rich three-garlic pasta using roasted, sautéed, and raw garlic together.

episodes.title: San Francisco Field Trip; Oysters; Unusual Ribbons
episodes.description: Martha takes a field trip to San Francisco to explore the city's exceptional food culture, visits an oyster bar, and returns to demonstrate how to properly shuck and serve raw oysters. She also shows how to make decorative ribbon arrangements.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving Table Setting
episodes.description: An episode on Thanksgiving preparation: Martha sets an elaborate holiday table with napkin folding, place cards, and a tablescape of autumn gourds and candles. She also makes a classic pumpkin pie and cranberry sauce.

episodes.title: Indian Cuisine
episodes.description: Martha explores Indian cooking: she makes naan bread in a cast-iron skillet, a fragrant chicken dish with whole spices, and a okra preparation from a regional tradition.

episodes.title: Pork Scaloppine
episodes.description: Martha makes pork scaloppine — thin cutlets pounded and sautéed in butter and white wine — along with herb power packs for cooking and matcha shortbread cookies, demonstrating the show's characteristic mix of cooking and gardening topics.

episodes.title: Making Jam
episodes.description: Martha walks through the summer jam-making process from picked fruit to sealed jar. She makes strawberry jam with the correct pectin ratio, a less-sweet blueberry preserve, and shows how to water-bath can safely for pantry storage.

episodes.title: Grilling
episodes.description: Martha demonstrates that grilling can be as refined as any indoor cooking. She butterflies a leg of lamb and chars it over hardwood coals, grills whole fish wrapped in grape leaves, and makes a summer succotash of corn and lima beans to serve alongside.

episodes.title: Winter Centerpieces
episodes.description: Martha builds elaborate winter centerpieces using only materials from the garden and farm: bare branches with hanging ornaments, forced paperwhites, and low arrangements of magnolia leaves, pinecones, and red berries. She explains how these living arrangements last longer than cut flowers.

episodes.title: Perfect Pie Crust
episodes.description: Martha addresses the domestic challenge many home bakers fear most: the flaky, tender pie crust. She demonstrates her two-fat method — butter for flavor, shortening for flakiness — and shows how to handle the dough properly in all temperatures. The lesson concludes with a classic pumpkin pie and an apple-cranberry double-crust.

episodes.title: Spring Cleaning
episodes.description: Martha applies her characteristic precision to household organization. She demonstrates a systematic approach to cleaning the refrigerator, organizing the linen closet with ribbon-tied stacks, and properly polishing silver with the correct cloth and compound.

episodes.title: Easy Craft and Sewing Projects
episodes.description: A crafts-focused episode with projects suitable for baby gifting: handmade baby invitations, sewn baby gifts, and decorative baby cakes. Part of MSL's regular rotation of accessible home-craft segments.

episodes.title: The Fish Show
episodes.description: Martha and her team devote an entire episode to seafood. She starts with fish prints — a Japanese gyotaku-style craft with Ray Bliss Rich — then makes mussels vinaigrette as an appetizer, takes viewers on a seafood market field trip, and finishes with lobster linguine.

guests.name: Ray Bliss Rich
guests.context: Appeared in Fish Prints craft segment

episodes.title: Halloween: Creepy Crafts and Dastardly Decor
episodes.description: A Halloween special episode featuring spooky crafts and décor — the kind of frightfully good projects that became an MSL signature: carved pumpkins, candied apples, cobweb centerpieces, and ghostly table settings.

episodes.title: Mexican Buffet
episodes.description: Martha stages a Mexican-themed buffet, complete with punch tin napkin rings, paper decorations, and a centerpiece arrangement of bright flowers. The cooking segment features red snapper Veracruz-style with tomatoes and olives.

episodes.title: Martha's Favorite Bloopers and Outtakes
episodes.description: A light-hearted compilation episode drawing on years of MSLTV outtakes and behind-the-scenes bloopers — the moments that didn't make air, the cakes that fell, the crafts that went sideways, and the animals that had other plans.

episodes.title: Big Martha and Little Martha
episodes.description: A rare, warmly personal episode in which Martha shares the studio with her mother, Martha Kostyra — 'Big Martha' to the family. They prepare beef roll-ups, a hearty mushroom barley soup, and Mrs. Kostyra demonstrates her favorite gentle exercises alongside her daughter.

guests.name: Martha Kostyra
guests.context: Martha Stewart's mother, affectionately nicknamed 'Big Martha'

episodes.title: April Fools' Day Classic MSLTV Bloopers
episodes.description: An April Fools' Day episode featuring a blooper reel that includes Martha's famous sponge cake gag, colorful egg-laying hens, tire flower centerpieces, and the introduction of her grandchild. Ends with a mango fool — the dessert, not the jokester.

episodes.title: Take Care: Martha's Tips for Living the Good Long Life
episodes.description: A wellness-themed segment (approximately 12 minutes) focused on longevity and healthy living habits, featuring Martha's practical guidance on health, exercise, and everyday wellbeing.

episodes.title: Big Martha Kostyra's Family Favorite Recipes
episodes.description: A second episode drawing on Mrs. Kostyra's family recipe archive, appearing to feature the same beef roll-up and mushroom barley content as MSL10131V in an alternate 40-minute compilation cut.

guests.name: Martha Kostyra
guests.context: Martha Stewart's mother; family recipes featured throughout

episodes.title: Back to School and Mrs. Kostyra's Birthday
episodes.description: A two-theme episode combining September's back-to-school energy with a birthday celebration for Martha's mother. Martha makes hot buttered pretzels perfect for lunchboxes, demonstrates evergreen foliage arrangements, bakes a leek and tomato frittata, and crafts button necklaces as birthday party favors.

guests.name: Martha Kostyra
guests.context: Martha Stewart's mother; birthday being celebrated in this episode

episodes.title: Martha's Thanksgiving Classics
episodes.description: A Thanksgiving-focused compilation episode (approximately 40 minutes) gathering MSL's most beloved turkey and holiday table content into a single celebratory program.

episodes.title: From Martha's Kitchen: MSL Edition
episodes.description: A special crossover episode drawing on 'From Martha's Kitchen' content, presenting a selection of MSL's most popular recipes in a streamlined 38-minute format.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.description: An October Halloween episode (approximately 39 minutes) focused on seasonal crafts, costumes, and spooky entertaining — one of MSL's hallmark seasonal programming blocks.

episodes.title: Pirate Ship Party
episodes.description: A Halloween episode built around a pirate theme: a time-lapse pirate ship set construction, pirate accessory costumes, a handmade pirate ship invitation, and a cooking segment of stuffed shells. Features a petkeeping segment on parrots.

episodes.title: Melting Pot: Mexico and Tamales with Diana Kennedy
episodes.description: Food writer and Mexican cuisine authority Diana Kennedy joins Martha for a deep dive into Mexican cooking. Kennedy, who has spent decades documenting regional Mexican food, demonstrates traditional tamale preparation — from masa to filling to husk-wrapping — while Martha handles a mole-inspired table setting.

guests.name: Diana Kennedy
guests.context: Foremost authority on Mexican regional cuisine; demonstrated traditional tamales

episodes.title: American Made: Sonoma, California
episodes.description: Part of MSL's 'American Made' travel series, this episode takes Martha to Sonoma County in California's wine country to explore local food and craft traditions.

episodes.title: Martha Stewart Living Series Finale
episodes.description: The final broadcast of Martha Stewart Living on Hallmark Channel after 11 seasons, airing February 10, 2004. Martha closed out an extraordinary run that had redefined domestic arts as a genre, a lifestyle, and a business. Production code MSL11232V.

episodes.title: The Perfect Thanksgiving Turkey Three Ways
episodes.description: Martha demonstrates her three favorite techniques for a perfect Thanksgiving turkey: roasted in the traditional oven, spatchcocked for faster more even cooking, and deep-fried in peanut oil for a shatteringly crisp skin. She covers brining, dry-rubbing, and carving.

episodes.title: Spectacular Thanksgiving Sides
episodes.description: The complete Thanksgiving side dish spread: Martha's classic mashed potatoes enriched with cream and butter, creamed spinach with a gruyère gratin, roasted Brussels sprouts with pancetta, and both a traditional stuffing and a cornbread dressing.

episodes.title: Martha's Thanksgiving Pies
episodes.description: Three Thanksgiving pies in one episode: the classic pumpkin with a perfectly spiced custard filling, a deep-dish apple with a lattice top and caramelized onion, and a pecan pie made with dark corn syrup for a rich, fudgy center.

episodes.title: Martha's Favorite Christmas Cookies
episodes.description: Martha's definitive holiday cookie assortment: the linzer cookie with raspberry jam, classic spritz pressed through a cookie gun, snickerdoodles rolled in cinnamon sugar, chocolate crinkles dusted in powdered snow, and decorated sugar cookies.

episodes.title: Gorgeous Gingerbread Houses From Start to Finish
episodes.description: Martha builds an architectural-grade gingerbread house from scratch — rolling, cutting, and baking the structural pieces, then assembling and decorating with royal icing, candies, and edible silver dust. She explains the load-bearing principles that keep the structure standing.

episodes.title: Celebrating Christmas
episodes.description: A complete Christmas celebration: Martha sets an elegant holiday table with fresh greenery and candlelight, makes her signature roast beef tenderloin with horseradish cream, and finishes with a classic yule log cake decorated to resemble a birch log.

episodes.title: New Year's Eve Cocktails and Hors D'oeuvres
episodes.description: The ultimate New Year's Eve party guide: Martha makes Champagne cocktails with gold luster dust, a caviar station with blini, smoked salmon toasts, and elegant goat cheese crostini — all designed for standing, mingling, and counting down.

episodes.title: Martha and the Hanukkah Hunks
episodes.description: Martha celebrates Hanukkah with a festive episode that combines traditional Jewish holiday cooking with some characteristically unexpected Martha touches. She makes her version of potato latkes with sour cream and applesauce, jelly doughnuts (sufganiyot), and a honey cake for the table.

episodes.title: Christmas Eve Seafood Dinner
episodes.description: An Italian-American Feast of the Seven Fishes tradition comes to Martha's table. She prepares baccalà (salted cod) fritters, spaghetti alle vongole, roasted branzino with fennel and olives, and a simple shrimp cocktail — a complete Christmas Eve seafood feast.

episodes.title: Christmas in the Country
episodes.description: Martha celebrates Christmas at her Bedford farm, embracing the pastoral traditions of her Connecticut home. She cuts fresh greens for a DIY wreath, makes a mulled wine for warming, and prepares a simple but memorable holiday lunch of potato leek soup and a crusty country loaf.

episodes.title: Christmas Panettone, Kris Kringle Bread Pudding, and More
episodes.description: Martha bakes a tall panettone from scratch — a two-day process resulting in a feathery, citrus-scented Italian Christmas bread — and then turns leftover panettone into a Kris Kringle bread pudding with a vanilla custard and dark rum sauce.

episodes.title: Homemade Holidays
episodes.description: The gift-giving episode: Martha makes a selection of handmade holiday gifts from the kitchen — spiced nuts in decorated jars, homemade vanilla extract, a chocolate bark with pistachios and dried cranberries — plus a section on beautiful, simple gift wrapping.

episodes.title: New Year's Eve
episodes.description: Martha rings in 2024 with a sophisticated New Year's Eve menu: oysters on the half shell with mignonette, a duck confit with cherry reduction, and a dramatic Baked Alaska flambéed at the table — the ideal showstopper for a decade's-end celebration.
